blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Hot Water System Replacement Cost in Southbank?
blogPosts.excerpt: Thinking of replacing your hot water system in Southbank? We break down prices for electric, gas, and solar units, plus installation costs and rebates.
body: Replacing a hot water system is one of the most common plumbing jobs in Southbank, and the cost can vary widely depending on the type, size, and complexity of the installation. In this guide, we'll give you a realistic picture of what you can expect to pay in 2026, along with factors that influence the final price.

For a standard electric storage tank (e.g., 125L to 160L), you're looking at around $850 to $1,200 fully installed. Gas continuous flow systems are more expensive, typically ranging from $1,500 to $2,500, but they offer lower running costs and endless hot water. Solar and heat pump systems can cost $3,000 to $5,000, though government rebates in Victoria can bring that down significantly.

Installation costs in Southbank also depend on the location of your existing unit. If it's in a tight roof cavity or requires new gas or electrical runs, expect additional charges. At 7 Day Plumbing & Gas, we always provide a fixed quote upfront so there are no surprises. We're happy to help you choose the most cost-effective option for your home.

Older apartment blocks in Southbank sometimes have unique challenges like shared flues or limited ventilation. Our team has extensive experience working in these situations and can advise on the best system that meets current Australian standards and your building's requirements.

Another factor is the warranty. Most quality hot water systems come with 5-10 years on the tank and 1-2 years on labour. We install brands like Rheem, Rinnai, and Dux, all backed by solid warranties. We also offer an extended labour warranty on our installations for added peace of mind.

If your current system is leaking or making strange noises, don't wait. A sudden failure can lead to water damage and costly repairs. Call Mark for a fast, same-day replacement in Southbank. We can usually have a new system up and running within a few hours.

Thinking about upgrading to a heat pump? These are becoming popular in Melbourne's climate because they use less electricity. The upfront cost is higher, but the long-term savings on your energy bill can offset that within 3-5 years. Plus, there are state rebates available for eligible households.

No matter which system you choose, the key is to work with a licensed plumber who knows the local regulations. Mark holds all necessary licences and can ensure your installation is compliant and safe. Give us a call for a free, no-obligation quote on your hot water replacement.

blogPosts.title: Emergency Plumber in Southbank: What to Do When a Pipe Bursts
blogPosts.excerpt: A burst pipe can cause serious water damage fast. Learn the immediate steps to take, why you need a local plumber, and how 7 Day Plumbing & Gas responds 24/7.
body: A burst pipe is every homeowner's nightmare, especially in Southbank where many properties have aging plumbing in high-rise apartments or old terrace houses. Water can flood your floors, ruin furniture, and even damage the building structure within minutes. Knowing exactly what to do can save you thousands in repairs.

First, locate your main water shut-off valve and turn it off immediately. In most Southbank homes, this is under the kitchen sink or near the laundry. If you're in an apartment, the shut-off may be in a common area or your bathroom. Once the water is off, open a cold tap to relieve pressure in the pipes.

Next, call an emergency plumber — this is where 7 Day Plumbing & Gas comes in. We offer 24/7 response across Southbank and can usually be at your door within an hour. Mark carries a full stock of fittings and replacement pipes so he can make a permanent repair on the spot, not just a temporary patch.

While waiting, mop up standing water and move valuable items to a dry area. If the leak is near electrical outlets, switch off the power at the breaker box to avoid electrocution. Take photos for your insurance claim — we can also provide a detailed report for your insurer.

Common causes of burst pipes in Southbank include old galvanised steel pipes that have corroded, sudden temperature drops causing frozen pipes (rare but possible in Melbourne winters), and physical damage from renovations. Preventative pipe relining can strengthen weak pipes and prevent future bursts.

At 7 Day Plumbing & Gas, we don't just fix the leak — we inspect your entire plumbing system to identify any other weak points. We'll give you honest advice about whether a pipe replacement or relining is the smarter long-term solution. Don't risk a second burst.

If you're in a rental property, contact your landlord or property manager immediately after turning off the water. As a tenant, you're not responsible for structural repairs, but you should still minimise damage and call a licensed plumber if the emergency is severe.

Remember: time is critical. Every hour of flooding increases the cost of restoration. Keep our number saved in your phone — 0414 932 613 — and rest assured that a real person will answer, not an answering machine. Mark lives locally and is ready to help.

blogPosts.title: Gas Fitting in Melbourne: Costs, Safety & Regulations for Southbank Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Thinking of installing a gas cooktop or heater in Southbank? We cover the costs, essential safety checks, and Victorian regulations you need to know.
body: Gas fitting is a job that must be done by a licensed professional — it's not just about connecting a hose. In Victoria, only registered gas fitters can legally work on gas appliances, and for good reason. Faulty gas work can lead to leaks, fires, or carbon monoxide poisoning. At 7 Day Plumbing & Gas, Mark holds a full gas fitting licence and has decades of experience.

The cost of installing a new gas cooktop in Southbank typically ranges from $350 to $800, depending on whether you need a new gas line run or if existing connections can be used. Gas heater installation is usually $400 to $1,000, with flued heaters costing more due to venting requirements.

Before any gas fitting begins, a site inspection is essential. Mark will check the existing gas pressure, meter location, and compliance with AS/NZS 5601 (the Australian gas installation standard). In older Southbank flats, the gas piping may be undersized or corroded, requiring an upgrade to handle modern appliances.

Gas safety isn't just about installation — regular servicing is critical. We recommend an annual gas safety check for all gas appliances, especially heaters. Signs of trouble include a yellow flame (should be blue), soot buildup, or a strong gas smell. If you smell gas, turn off the supply at the meter, open windows, and call us immediately.

In Melbourne, the gas network is managed by Multinet Gas (east) or AusNet Services (west), depending on your suburb. For Southbank, it's typically Multinet. We liaise with them on your behalf for new connections or meter upgrades, saving you the hassle.

Thinking of switching from electric to gas for cooking or heating? Many Southbank residents are doing this to enjoy instant control and lower running costs. We can quote on running a new gas line from the meter to your kitchen or living room, including all necessary trenching and pipework.

One common mistake homeowners make is buying a gas appliance before checking if it's compatible with their existing setup. Let us help you choose the right model that meets Australian standards and fits your home's gas pressure. We can also arrange warranty registration and provide a compliance certificate.

Remember, unlicensed gas work is illegal and dangerous. Always ask to see your gas fitter's licence. Mark's licence number is 47432, and we're happy to show it. Call us for a free quote on any gas fitting job in Southbank or the surrounding suburbs.

blogPosts.title: Blocked Drains in Southbank — Common Causes and How We Fix Them
blogPosts.excerpt: Blocked drains are a nightmare. Learn what causes them in Southbank homes and how our modern drain-clearing methods get your plumbing flowing again.
body: Blocked drains are one of the most frustrating plumbing issues in Southbank, whether it's a slow-draining sink or a completely blocked toilet. The causes are often the same: grease buildup, hair, food scraps, or tree roots invading old clay pipes. In high-rise apartments, shared drainage lines can cause problems for multiple units at once.

Our first step is always a CCTV drain inspection. We send a small camera down the pipe to see exactly what's causing the blockage and where it is. This avoids guesswork and unnecessary digging. The inspection typically costs around $120 and is included in the repair if you book with us.

For grease and scale buildup, we use high-pressure water jetting — a powerful stream of water that scours the pipe walls clean. This is much more effective than a traditional plunger or snake. For tree roots, we have specialised cutting tools that can grind through roots without damaging the pipe, followed by jetting to flush debris.

In older Southbank properties (especially those built pre-1970s), you may have earthenware or cast iron drains that are prone to cracks and root intrusion. In these cases, we often recommend pipe relining — a trenchless method that creates a new pipe inside the old one. It's durable, cost-effective, and saves you from digging up your yard or driveway.

Prevention is better than cure. We advise Southbank homeowners to avoid pouring cooking oil down the sink, use drain strainers, and have their drains professionally cleaned every 12-18 months. If you notice gurgling sounds or foul odours, it's a sign of developing blockage — don't ignore it.

For commercial properties like cafes and restaurants in Southbank, grease traps must be maintained regularly. We can service those too, ensuring compliance with local council regulations. Blocked drains can shut down a business, so proactive maintenance is a smart investment.

Our response time for blocked drains in Southbank is usually within a couple of hours during business hours, and we offer 24/7 emergency service for urgent cases. Mark brings a fully equipped van with CCTV, jetting, and pipe tools, so most blockages are cleared on the first visit.

If you're dealing with a blocked drain in Southbank, don't reach for chemical drain cleaners — they can damage your pipes and are bad for the environment. Give us a call instead. We'll fix the problem properly and give you advice on keeping your drains clear for good.
